name: Chlorphentermine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Venezuela, first in 1967 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: Chlorphentermine was removed from the market in Germany and Venezuela starting in 1967 due to heart harm and breathing problems [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high heart score and a low liver score for this drug [M]. Closely related drugs were also pulled from markets in several countries for heart, breathing, or liver damage [3][4].
